parameters.query:
=SELECT 
  tu.id,
  tu.email,
  tu.tenant_id,
  tu.role,
  tu.created_at,
  t.name as tenant_name,
  t.slug as tenant_slug
FROM public.tenant_users tu
LEFT JOIN public.tenants t ON tu.tenant_id = t.id
WHERE tu.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
  AND tu.ativo = true
ORDER BY tu.created_at DESC;

=INSERT INTO public.login_audit (
  tenant_id,
  user_id,
  email,
  success,
  metadata
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.tenant_id }}'::uuid,
  '{{ $json.usuario_id }}'::uuid,
  '{{ $json.email }}',
  true,
  '{"action": "onboarding_email_sent", "sent_at": "' || NOW() || '"}'::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
